title: Canonical evaluation of a normalized lifted pure tensor.
statement: Let X be a scheme, F a quasi-coherent O_X-module, U and W objects of its small etale site, g:W→U, and n a natural number. Let f from degree n of the singleton Amitsur complex to degree n of the singleton tensor-section Cech complex satisfy [new-etale-affine-singleton-tensor-degree-comparison-hom-normalization]. Use the standard product witnesses to form P, the product of n+1 copies of W over U, N=Γ(P,P*F), and q, evaluation at the sole outer Cech index followed by ULift.down. For every coefficient m in Γ(U,U*F) and every family b of n+1 functions on W, q(f(ULift.up(m tensor tprod(b)))) equals (product of the projection pullbacks of b(k)) times the normalized restriction of m to P. This is an equality for the prescribed pure tensor, not an assertion of range membership or surjectivity.

source.place: Tag 03P2, affine tensor calculation; explicit pure-tensor normalization

proof.text: Unfold the normalization predicate. Both presentations use the same finite scheme product and the same outer additive-group product diagrams. Their HasLimit witnesses inhabit the same propositions, so proof irrelevance identifies them. Evaluation of the composite additive map q.comp f.hom on the explicit lifted pure tensor is projection at the sole index followed by ULift.down. Thus its value is the left side of the given normalization equation, which equals the prescribed pure section. This transport uses no affine hypothesis. The n=0, zero-function, zero-module and empty-scheme cases use the same calculation.

proof_origin.place: Tag 03P2; definitional evaluation of the normalization equation with canonical product witnesses

theorem singletonTensorDegreeComparisonHom_pure_image
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (U W : X.Etale) (g : W ⟶ U) (n : ℕ)
    (f : (singletonTensorAmitsur X F U W g).X n ⟶
      (singletonTensorCech X F U W g).X n)
    (hf : IsSingletonTensorDegreeComparisonHom X F U W g n f) :
    letI : Algebra Γ(U.left, ⊤) Γ(W.left, ⊤) := g.left.appTop.hom.toAlgebra
    let P := ∏ᶜ (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) ↦ Over.mk g)
    let N := Γ((Modules.tensorPullback P.left.hom).obj F, ⊤)
    let D : (Fin (n + 1) → Fin 1) → AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} :=
      fun _ ↦ AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} N)
    let q : (singletonTensorCech X F U W g).X n →+ N :=
      (AddEquiv.ulift : ULift.{u + 1} N ≃+ N).toAddMonoidHom.comp
        (Pi.π D (fun _ ↦ 0)).hom
    ∀ (m : Γ((Modules.tensorPullback U.hom).obj F, ⊤))
      (b : Fin (n + 1) → Γ(W.left, ⊤)),
      (q.comp f.hom) (ULift.up.{u + 1, u}
        (m ⊗ₜ[Γ(U.left, ⊤)] PiTensorProduct.tprod Γ(U.left, ⊤) b)) =
        (∏ k : Fin (n + 1),
          (Pi.π (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) ↦ Over.mk g) k).left.left.appTop (b k)) •
            Modules.etaleTensorSectionsRestriction F P.hom m
